.env.example.before:
# Worksheet tabs use built-in names. Only add GOOGLE_SHEETS_*_WORKSHEET_NAME
# overrides when existing workbook tabs have different names (see README).
GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID=
GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID=
GOOGLE_DRIVE_MAKE_FILES_READABLE_BY_LINK=false
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=
GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN=
GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL=
GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY="-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----\n"
LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET=
LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN=
# Separate purchase-app URL used by the Purchase rich menu.
PUBLIC_BASE_URL=
# Inventra URL used by the Order and Movement rich menus.
NEW_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=
# Account source: env (default/rollback) or sheet. See README before switching.
LOYVERSE_ACCOUNT_SOURCE=env
LOYVERSE_ACCOUNTS_JSON=[]
# Sheet mode reads loyverse_accounts from GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID above.

# Optional override for movement links. Defaults to PUBLIC_BASE_URL.
MOVEMENT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=

# Movement flow: quantity_photo (current/default) or photo_only. Redeploy after changing.
MOVEMENT_CREATE_MODE=quantity_photo
